close_reason: Created tests/helpers.rs and tests/addressbook_tests.rs (4 tests: get, changes, set create, onDestroyRemoveContents); clippy clean
description:
**What:** Create crate-jmap-contacts-client/tests/contacts_addressbook_tests.rs with 6 async wiremock tests. Oracle: draft-ietf-jmap-contacts-10 §4.1 (AddressBook/get example), §4.2 (onSuccessSetIsDefault example), §2.3 (set args).

**Tests:**
1. address_book_get_returns_spec_example: mock returns §4.1 fixture; assert first AB name=="Personal", is_default==true, my_rights.may_read==true.
2. address_book_get_null_ids_sends_ids_null: assert request body has "ids":null when ids=None passed.
3. address_book_changes_returns_correct_states: assert old_state, new_state, has_more_changes==false, updated contains "ab1".
4. address_book_set_on_success_set_is_default_sends_correct_wire: pass onSuccessSetIsDefault as string id; assert request body contains "onSuccessSetIsDefault":"<id>" and does NOT contain "onDestroyRemoveContents".
5. address_book_set_on_destroy_remove_contents_serializes: pass onDestroyRemoveContents=true; assert request body contains "onDestroyRemoveContents":true.
6. address_book_get_401_returns_error: mock responds 401; assert result is Err.

**Acceptance criteria:** All 6 tests pass. Mock verified called once each.
title: Wiremock tests: AddressBook/get /changes /set
